class.name: VCSVUtil
class.brief_description:
Static convenience helpers built on the parser and type inference.
基于解析器和类型推断的静态便捷工具。
class.description:
One-line helpers: [method parse] / [method parse_file] alias [VCSVParser]; [method load_csv_dict_array] reads a CSV and returns typed [Dictionary] rows (CSVAccess-style); [method detect_types] returns the inferred type name per column; [method type_name] names a Variant.
一行式工具：[method parse] / [method parse_file] 是 [VCSVParser] 的别名；[method load_csv_dict_array] 读取 CSV 并返回类型化 [Dictionary] 行（CSVAccess 风格）；[method detect_types] 返回每列推断出的类型名；[method type_name] 命名一个 Variant。

method.name: parse
method.description:
Alias for [method VCSVParser.parse_string].
[method VCSVParser.parse_string] 的别名。

method.name: parse_file
method.description:
Alias for [method VCSVParser.parse_file].
[method VCSVParser.parse_file] 的别名。

method.name: detect_types
method.description:
Returns header→canonical-type-name for each column (e.g. [code]{"hp": "int"}[/code]).
返回每列的 header→规范类型名（如 [code]{"hp": "int"}[/code]）。

method.name: load_csv_dict_array
method.description:
Reads [param csv_path] and returns an [Array] of typed [Dictionary] rows (cells converted by inferred column types). Empty on failure.
读取 [param csv_path] 并返回类型化 [Dictionary] 行的 [Array]（单元格按推断列类型转换）。失败时为空。

method.name: table_to_dict_array
method.description:
Converts a string table into an [Array] of [Dictionary] with inferred cell types (the engine behind [method load_csv_dict_array]).
把字符串表转换为带推断单元格类型的 [Dictionary] 的 [Array]（[method load_csv_dict_array] 背后的引擎）。

method.name: type_name
method.description:
Canonical type name of [param value] ("int", "Vector2", "String", ...).
[param value] 的规范类型名（"int"、"Vector2"、"String" 等）。
